Economics: ~45st/R1.5 column ≈ $122M/yr; high-reflux 70st ≈ $297M/yr. Prizes: C6paraffin blend (2,2-DMB+2-MP+3-MP+nC6, 970 mol/s) ≈ $1181M/yr; C5mix (iC5+nC5, 695 mol/s) ≈ $618M/yr; nC5 pure $439M; C4mix $186M; nC4 $166M. Need ≥95% (99% for 1.2x).

Key gaps: C4/C5 split = 28 K (easy); C5/C6 (nC5 309 vs 2,2-DMB 323) = 14 K (tight); C6paraffin/naphthene (336/342 vs 345/354) = very tight, probably infeasible in budget.

Prior failures: front cuts leak (T held nC5/iC5; B held nC4 8%), so 95% never reached. High reflux converges poorly.

PLAN (3 solves left): try 2-column C5-mix route: front 60/3.0 (C4-/C5+), bottoms 80/5.0 (C5mix/C6+). If BT ≥95% C5mix, revenue $618M vs ~$250M cost → positive reward. Empty fallback = 0.
